# Why did eBay reject my bulk listing file?

> Catch what breaks an eBay bulk listing upload, with the line number, before you upload. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
